item.title: Fans Worry Sale Of WB To Netflix Could Turn Comic Book Movies Into Soulless Cash Grabs
item.description: U.S. — Movie fans across the country have expressed concern that Warner Bros' sale to Netflix could lead to comic book movies becoming over-bloated, soulless cash grabs.

item.title: Nigerian Prince Scammed By Somali Immigrant
item.description: LAGOS, NIGERIA — In yet another case of fraud perpetrated by Somalis, a Nigerian prince fell prey to an online scam perpetrated by a Somali immigrant.

item.title: Special Needs Community Demands People Stop Comparing Them To Tim Walz
item.description: U.S. — Americans with cognitive disabilities and other special needs have demanded that people stop comparing them to Tim Walz.
